t: Slide switch angle grinder with no-volt release switch preventing unintentional start when locked on. Switch must be manually reset before power is delivered. High efficiency motor improves performance in demanding applications. New guard design allows tool-free fitment, adjustment or removal for increased flexibility. Ergonomic design with low profile gear case for easier access in confined areas and anti-vibration side handle for improved comfort. Anti-lock flange prevents permanent lock-up. Replaceable brushes, fully leaded stator windings and abrasion-protected motor give greater motor durability.
